crossRefs.note: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout…
Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
Hadad, Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

people.name: Hagri
people.line: A Gadite, father of Mibhar, one of David's mighty men.

people.name: Jetur
people.line: A descendant of Ishmael and a region in Syria

people.name: Kedemah
people.line: A son of Ishmael; Nodab, a Hagrite tribe

people.name: Naphish
people.line: Son of Ishmael, defeated by Reubenites, Gadites, and Manassites.

translations.web: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.
translations.bsb: They waged war against the Hagrites, as well as Jetur, Naphish, and Nodab.
translations.kjv: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.
translations.asv: And they made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.
